purpose: Deterministic research queue for all 825 VinMerge model slices. This is an execution layer only; it does not alter the authoritative 825-model master.

priority_definition.1: Highest missing-identifier risk; execute first when authoritative sources are available.
priority_definition.2: Partial identifier coverage; execute after priority 1.
priority_definition.3: Chassis-first coverage; execute configuration and fitment expansion.
priority_definition.4: Near/full identifier coverage; concentrate on fitment, supersession and aftermarket mapping.

evidence_policy: Authoritative or manufacturer-linked evidence is required for positive identification/configuration and vehicle-to-part claims. Lower-tier sources can discover candidates but cannot independently establish authoritative fitment.
